hero_subhead: Faulty socket or dead circuit? G D Walker Electrical arrives fast and fixes it right first time, every time.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires, we handle domestic and commercial electrical work with speed and precision.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped circuits, or dead sockets? We diagnose and fix electrical faults quickly, with parts carried on the van. Available 24/7.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Installation
services.desc: Full boiler replacement and heating system installation. New systems improve efficiency, cut your bills, and come with warranty cover.

services.title: House Rewires & Upgrades
services.desc: Tired electrics or moving into an older property? We complete full house rewires to modern safety standards, often in 2–3 days.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuse boxes are unreliable and unsafe. We replace them with modern RCD-protected consumer units that meet current building regs.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Mysterious power dips or safety concerns? We use professional test equipment to identify hidden faults before they become dangerous.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Electrical
services.desc: Office rewires, factory maintenance, and industrial installations. We plan around your business hours and minimise downtime.

about_pullquote: I got into this trade because I wanted to do electrical work properly, not cut corners.
about_para_1: G D Walker Electrical has been serving Leeds homeowners and businesses for over 20 years. Founded on the principle that reliable electrical work shouldn't cost the earth, we've built a solid reputation for turning up on time, fixing problems thoroughly, and charging fairly. We're NICEIC registered and stay current with all building regulations and safety standards.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, explain what needs doing, and never oversell. Whether it's a late-night emergency or a planned renovation, you'll get the same straight-talking, no-nonsense approach. We carry common parts, so most jobs are completed in a single visit.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Customers Say About G D Walker Electrical

reviews.text: Got a call from our electrician saying we needed a new consumer unit. Called G D Walker for a second opinion. They came same day, explained the situation clearly, and quoted a fair price. Work done the next morning and it's been flawless since. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Our boiler died on a Sunday evening. Called at 6pm, they were here by 8pm with a replacement. Professional job, reasonable price, and they even cleaned up properly. You don't expect that level of service these days. Top marks.
reviews.author: Catherine P.

reviews.text: Had our whole house rewired by G D Walker. No faffing about, no hidden extras, finished when they said they would. Friendly lads who knew their job inside out. Already recommended them to three friends.
reviews.author: David M.
